title: Goods and Services Tax — Registration & Periodic Return Filing
authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
version: CGST Act 2017, Section 22 (paraphrased; verify current notifications)
notes: special_category_states is deliberately left empty -- the exact current list under GST Council notifications needs verification before use. goods/services thresholds (Rs 40L/20L standard, Rs 20L/10L special-category) and the QRMP Rs 5 crore ceiling are the well-established general figures; exact statutory filing due dates (20th/22nd/24th) vary by scheme and state group and are approximated here.
